ModMetaData.name: Custom Base Framework
ModMetaData.author: Evil Eye Guy
ModMetaData.description:
Custom Base Framework builds NPC settlements from reusable buildings (pieces). A settlement plan specifies the faction/tech-level it belongs to, pieces that shall be used, fortifications and inhabitants. The settlement generator arranges them around the terrain of each map, with connecting roads, fields and animal pens.
Every faction can be switched off in the mod settings. An editor for your own buildings, towns, loot and units is included.
Its guide is in the mod folder under Wiki/Open Guide.html.
